relation_statement: The dtype used to cast the input activation must equal the actual (post-wrapping) parameter dtype under guard that the module is wrapped by a sharding framework after construction.
observable_signal: dtype of the tensor entering the kernel compared against the live conv weight dtype at forward time
validity_precondition: sequence-mixer modules whose parameters are re-wrapped (FSDP/FSDP2) after construction, mixed-precision params
evidence_from_issue: Mamba.forward casts inputs using cached self.dtype — wrong dtype after FSDP wraps the conv1d weight
evidence_from_fix: self.dtype was a construction-time snapshot; after FSDP wrapping the actual parameter dtype changed, so x flowed into the kernel in the wrong precision

relation_statement: The FFN output must equal the reference gated computation silu(w1(h)) * w3(h) under guard that a SwiGLU-style gated FFN is configured.
observable_signal: elementwise difference between the module output and a reference SwiGLU computation on the same inputs
validity_precondition: boundary-predictor FFN configured as SwiGLU; applies whenever the gated FFN path executes
evidence_from_issue: F.silu called with two arguments — silu treats w3(h) as inplace flag, drops gating
evidence_from_fix: the intended SwiGLU gate (silu(w1(h)) * w3(h)) never executed, so the FFN computed silu(w1(h)) alone

relation_statement: The learning rate at each training progress point must follow the configured sqrt-decay functional form 1-sqrt(1-progress) under guard that the sqrt decay scheduler is selected.
observable_signal: logged learning-rate time series compared against the closed-form schedule value at each step
validity_precondition: sqrt decay LR scheduler active, during the decay phase of training
evidence_from_issue: sqrt decay LR schedule uses wrong formula — decay curve inverted
evidence_from_fix: sqrt(progress) instead of 1-sqrt(1-progress) — wrong decay curve shape

relation_statement: Router gate scores must remain strictly positive (bounded away from exact zero) before any downstream log or divide under guard that a sigmoid gating function runs in low precision.
observable_signal: min of router scores hitting exactly 0.0, or -inf/NaN appearing in the aux/load-balancing loss
validity_precondition: MoE router with sigmoid gating; downstream code takes log or divides by the score
evidence_from_issue: F.sigmoid(logits) without epsilon — exact-zero scores propagate as NaN through downstream log
evidence_from_fix: scores could underflow to exactly 0.0 under low precision, and downstream log/divide produced -inf/NaN that silently propagated into the final loss

relation_statement: The gradient accumulation dtype of the fused loss kernel must match the fp32 accumulation precision of the unfused baseline under guard that mixed-precision training uses the fused linear+CE implementation.
observable_signal: dtype of the fused kernel's gradient accumulation buffer; divergence of loss curves vs the unfused baseline
validity_precondition: LM head uses fused linear cross-entropy implementation under bf16 mixed precision
evidence_from_issue: fused_linear_cross_entropy_loss accumulates gradient in bf16 by default — silently noisier than fp32 accumulation
evidence_from_fix: the fused call defaulted accum_grad to bf16, which silently degraded gradient precision on the LM head and shifted loss curves vs the unfused baseline

relation_statement: The embedding initialization std must compensate for the input embed_scale multiplier so the scaled embedding magnitude stays at the intended scale under guard that embed_scale is configured.
observable_signal: norm/std of the scaled embedding output at the transformer input (orders of magnitude above intended scale)
validity_precondition: fan_in init method selected together with a nontrivial embed_scale (e.g., sqrt(d_model))
evidence_from_issue: fan_in init for embeddings ignores embed_scale — embeddings remain std=1.0 and become huge after scaling
evidence_from_fix: init always used std=1.0; the transformer then multiplied embeddings by embed_scale, producing embeddings several orders of magnitude larger than intended

relation_statement: The data-loader position counters must be reset to zero at the start of each evaluation pass under guard that the evaluator reuses a loader whose previous pass was truncated.
observable_signal: tokens_processed/batches_processed value at eval-pass start being nonzero; differing eval scores for repeated evals of the same checkpoint
validity_precondition: evaluator runs multiple passes over the same loader with eval_duration truncating each pass
evidence_from_issue: second eval pass starts mid-stream, evaluating a different subset
evidence_from_fix: Evaluator.__iter__ called reshuffle() but did not reset(); counters from the previous truncated eval persisted so the next pass started at a stale offset

relation_statement: The bookkeeping completion callback must finish before the join returns and before any state snapshot is captured under guard that an async bookkeeping op with a completion callback is in flight.
observable_signal: state_dict capture observing pre-callback state (e.g., un-rotated checkpoint indexes) after join has returned
validity_precondition: trainer launches an async bookkeeping op (e.g., async checkpoint save) whose callback mutates state later captured by state_dict()
evidence_from_issue: bookkeeping callback fires after future is FINISHED — state_dict snapshot can capture pre-callback state
evidence_from_fix: add_done_callback runs after the future is marked FINISHED, so _join_bookkeeping_ops returned before cb ran and a state_dict() capture could observe stale callback state

relation_statement: The recorded gradient-norm metric must equal the true global gradient norm without an extra cross-rank reduction under guard TP is enabled and grad clipping is active.
observable_signal: recorded grad_norm metric compared against a recomputed global norm of the full gradients
validity_precondition: grad clipper callback active with max_grad_norm set; clip_grad_norm_ returns a distributed tensor
evidence_from_issue: Grad clipper recorded grad_norm DTensor — record_metric saw distributed value
evidence_from_fix: the raw DTensor grad_norm was not unwrapped; the metric system operated on it across ranks, producing a wrongly reduced grad-norm value

relation_statement: The loss normalization divisor must be strictly positive so the normalized loss stays finite under guard that instance masking may remove all tokens on a rank.
observable_signal: batch token-count-for-loss equal to 0 on a rank, or NaN in the reported loss
validity_precondition: instance masking enabled; batches where all instances on a rank can be masked
evidence_from_issue: NaN loss when all instances on a rank are masked — division by zero
evidence_from_fix: batch_num_tokens_for_loss = 0 when all instances masked, causing loss / 0 = NaN

relation_statement: Each rank's contribution to the globally reduced loss must be proportional to its count of kept (unmasked) tokens under guard that per-rank sum-then-allreduce averaging is used.
observable_signal: globally reduced loss/gradient magnitude compared against a token-count-weighted reference average across ranks
validity_precondition: instance_mask present in the batch and at least one rank has masked instances
evidence_from_issue: Instance filter loss divisor missed masked-out instance tokens — wrong gradient scale
evidence_from_fix: ranks with fewer kept tokens contributed an artificially large per-token loss, producing an unfair weighted average across the data-parallel group and a wrong gradient magnitude

relation_statement: The loss value driving skip-step statistics, and hence the skip decision, must be identical across all ranks under guard world_size > 1.
observable_signal: per-rank latest_loss values or skip-step decision bits differing across ranks at the same step
validity_precondition: skip-step optimizer active; loss consumed before the global all-reduce
evidence_from_issue: SkipStepOptimizer fed unreduced ce_batch_loss — skip decisions on per-rank values
evidence_from_fix: latest_loss was set from the local per-rank loss before the all-reduce; skip-step decisions diverged across ranks, producing inconsistent optimizer behavior

relation_statement: The constructed layer's effective head dimension must match the dimension implied by the configured model width and head count under guard that the layer derives its own internal layout.
observable_signal: constructed layer head_dim attribute compared against d_model/n_heads at build time
validity_precondition: ladder configurator injects layer kwargs for a sequence mixer that derives head_dim internally
evidence_from_issue: ladder hard-coded head_dim from d_model/n_heads — wrong with FLA defaults
evidence_from_fix: injecting an externally-rounded head_dim made the constructed layer disagree with the configured d_model/n_heads, so the effective head dimension differed from what other code assumed

relation_statement: The byte embedding initialization distribution (mean/std) must match the teacher embedding statistics after the init-fix routine runs under guard that distillation with target embeddings is configured.
observable_signal: mean/std of the byte embedding weights after init compared against the computed teacher-embedding mean/std
validity_precondition: encoder init-fix called with target (teacher) embeddings provided in distillation training
evidence_from_issue: byte embeddings never initialized to teacher-embedding stats — kept default kaiming
evidence_from_fix: te_mean and te_std were used only for hash_embeddings; the main embedding weight was never assigned the te-scaled init, so its distribution did not match the teacher's vocabulary embeddings

relation_statement: The sliding-window mask value at each (query,key) pair must equal the logical AND of both one-sided window conditions under guard that a two-sided sliding window is configured.
observable_signal: mask entries that are True where only one of the two window conditions holds (attention reaching outside the window on one side)
validity_precondition: flex-attention backend selected with a two-sided sliding-window attention configuration
evidence_from_issue: sliding-window mask used Python `and` on tensors — short-circuit returned wrong mask
evidence_from_fix: Python's `and` short-circuits on bool() of the first operand, never producing the intended logical AND; the mask was computed as a single one-sided comparison

relation_statement: Parameters designated as frozen (including those shared with the teacher path) must be excluded from gradient updates under guard that teacher-student block sharing is enabled.
observable_signal: nonzero parameter deltas or requires_grad=True on shared block parameters that were intended frozen
validity_precondition: stage-1 distillation training with blocks shared between teacher and student and a freeze pattern applied
evidence_from_issue: stage1 froze only teacher.* — student blocks updated against teacher gradient
evidence_from_fix: shared block parameters live under 'blocks.*' and were not matched by the 'teacher.*' freeze pattern, so blocks were unfrozen and trained against gradients including teacher-path contributions

relation_statement: The document packing order must follow the intended sort order of the length key without unsigned-integer wraparound under guard that keys are negated for descending sort.
observable_signal: packed-document sequence violating the intended (descending) length ordering; negated uint32 keys wrapping to huge positive values
validity_precondition: document packing path that sorts documents by a uint32-typed length key
evidence_from_issue: Document packing sort overflow — uint32 * -1 wraps to huge positive
evidence_from_fix: root_cause not provided in the curated record

relation_statement: A user-configured field must survive the configuration serialize/reconstruct (merge) round-trip with its configured value under guard that CLI overrides are merged.
observable_signal: effective freeze_experts value after merge differing from the user-specified value; router gradients for the first expert half unexpectedly zero
validity_precondition: config class whose field is set in __init__ rather than declared; any override applied via the merge path
evidence_from_issue: freeze_experts assigned in __init__ instead of dataclass field — OmegaConf merge dropped it
evidence_from_fix: the serialize/reconstruct merge drops fields not declared as dataclass attributes; freeze_experts always reverted to the default regardless of the configured value, silently zeroing the first half of router gradients

relation_statement: Every trainable parameter of a module must receive its designated initialization before training starts under guard that subclass modules are dispatched by the init method.
observable_signal: weight statistics of the extra projection matrices at step 0 showing uninitialized (empty-allocation) values instead of the designated init distribution
validity_precondition: attention subclass with additional projections handled by an isinstance-ordered init dispatch
evidence_from_issue: MultiHeadLatentAttention init dispatched to Attention branch — wrong layers initialized
evidence_from_fix: the subclass branch was never reached because isinstance matched the parent class first; wq_a, wkv_a, wkv_b were never initialized, left at dtype-empty allocation values

relation_statement: The QK normalization axis of the cloned model must match the per-head normalization of the reference architecture under guard that the model claims equivalence to that reference.
observable_signal: none_runtime: within a single run nothing violates; divergence is observable only against an external reference implementation's attention scores
validity_precondition: reference-clone model config where the reference uses per-head QK norm
evidence_from_issue: Qwen3Clone-8B script forgot use_head_qk_norm — used per-channel QK norm instead of per-head
evidence_from_fix: the default per-channel QK norm was applied instead, normalizing across the wrong axis and producing different attention scores from the reference Qwen3

relation_statement: Ratio statistics must be averaged only over mask-valid byte positions, not the full padded tensor, under guard that batches contain padded positions.
observable_signal: computed true_ratio/average_prob compared against a masked-mean recomputation; systematic downward bias when padding fraction is high
validity_precondition: ratio-loss computation on variable-length byte batches with padding present
evidence_from_issue: H-Net ratio loss averaged over padded positions — wrong target ratio under variable-length batches
evidence_from_fix: means were taken over the full padded byte tensor instead of byte_mask-valid positions; padded zeros shrank both quantities toward 0, biasing the ratio-loss target

relation_statement: Every loss component entering the weighted sum must be normalized by the same divisor (token count) as its siblings under guard that the component is active in the combined loss.
observable_signal: magnitude of the un-normalized component exceeding its configured weight share by a factor ~ seq_len*batch_size relative to normalized components
validity_precondition: distillation transformer with the embed-loss component enabled in the weighted-sum loss
evidence_from_issue: H-Net embed loss never normalized by loss_div_factor — wrong loss weighting
evidence_from_fix: the finalize call was omitted for hnet_embed_loss; the component entered the weighted sum as a raw sum, inflating its effective weight by roughly seq_len * batch_size

relation_statement: Each loss component must be divided by the position count of its own granularity (byte positions for byte loss, patch positions for patch loss) under guard that multi-granularity losses are combined.
observable_signal: ratio of byte-loss to patch-loss magnitudes deviating from the configured weighting by the byte/patch position-count mismatch factor
validity_precondition: distillation transformer with a patch-level loss divisor configured alongside byte-level losses
evidence_from_issue: patch loss div factor used input_ids.numel() — wrong scaling for byte-level losses
evidence_from_fix: the correct denominator is the number of byte positions, with an analogous division by patch positions for the patch loss; the mismatch silently mis-weighted byte vs patch loss components

relation_statement: The flex-attention backend's output must agree (within tolerance) with the reference SDPA backend on the same inputs under guard that both claim the same attention semantics in bf16 training.
observable_signal: divergence of attention outputs / loss trajectories between the flex and SDPA backends on identical inputs
validity_precondition: flex-attention backend selected with bf16 inputs while the reference path computes in fp32
evidence_from_issue: Flex attention not upcast to fp32 — precision mismatch with SDPA backend
evidence_from_fix: flex attention ran directly on bf16 q/k/v while SDPA runs matmul/softmax in fp32, silently producing lower-precision outputs and different loss trajectories between backends

relation_statement: The number of key positions each query can attend to must equal the configured sliding-window size under guard that sliding-window attention is enabled.
observable_signal: per-row count of unmasked attention positions compared against the configured window size (off by one)
validity_precondition: attention configured with a sliding window
evidence_from_issue: Sliding window size off-by-one — window 1 token too small
evidence_from_fix: root_cause not provided in the curated record

relation_statement: Label indices at boundary positions must lie in the offset (boundary-fused) vocabulary range in every forward branch under guard that boundary fusing is enabled.
observable_signal: label values at boundary-mask positions below the fused-vocabulary offset (offset never applied) in the first forward branch
validity_precondition: distillation decoder with fuse_boundaries enabled; applies to the label tensor before cross-entropy
evidence_from_issue: missed first-call label_offsets when fuse_boundaries enabled
evidence_from_fix: the offset-application path was duplicated but missed in the first forward branch, so cross-entropy compared against the wrong target indices for boundary tokens

relation_statement: Padded positions must be excluded from label offsetting and remain at the ignore index under guard that fused-boundary label offsets are applied to variable-length batches.
observable_signal: label entries at byte_mask-invalid (padded) positions differing from the ignore_index
validity_precondition: fused-boundary label construction on batches containing padded byte positions
evidence_from_issue: shift_boundary_mask did not AND with byte_mask — pad positions polluted label offsets
evidence_from_fix: padded positions with leftover True boundary_mask received the vocab offset on labels that should have remained at ignore_index, distorting CE on padded positions

relation_statement: The total number of constructed dataset instances must be at least training_steps * batch_size (matching the requested per-source token budget) under guard that a source-mixture dataset backs a fixed-step run.
observable_signal: total instance count vs required count; epoch counter incrementing (entering epoch 2) before the configured step budget is exhausted; unexpected loss drop near end of run
validity_precondition: mixture dataset with per-source ratios; training step budget near the dataset boundary
evidence_from_issue: rounded down per-source instances — dataset shorter than expected
evidence_from_fix: integer-floor of tokens_requested_per_path // sequence_length dropped per-path remainders, so total instances < training_steps * batch_size and the trainer silently ran into epoch 2

relation_statement: Instances served from a cached index must conform to the currently configured sequence layout (sequence_length, bos handling) under guard that a disk cache from a prior run exists.
observable_signal: actual instance layout (sequence length / token boundaries) of served batches differing from the configured sequence_length
validity_precondition: fixed-sequence-length dataset variants with on-disk cached offsets; a later run changed layout-determining settings not included in the fingerprint
evidence_from_issue: fingerprint missed sequence_length / bos_token_id — wrong cache reused
evidence_from_fix: cached instance offsets computed under previous settings were reused when those settings changed, so returned instances no longer matched the configured sequence_length

relation_statement: Expert supervision label indices must fall within the range of active experts of the deployed model under guard that routing labels are generated by the data collator.
observable_signal: max expert-label index vs number of active experts; an expert-label slot that never receives router probability mass or gradient
validity_precondition: SFT with expert-routing supervision; data sources mapped by the collator's source-to-expert table
evidence_from_issue: DataCollator routed academic/technical sources to a non-existent 4th expert label
evidence_from_fix: the one-hot at index 3 pointed to an unused expert slot while only 3 experts were active, so router supervision was silently directed to a slot the router never produced gradient for

relation_statement: Every loss term added to the optimized combined loss must be attached to the autograd graph (contribute nonzero gradient) under guard that the regularizer's multiplier is set.
observable_signal: requires_grad/grad_fn of the z_loss tensor entering combined_loss; zero gradient contribution from the z_loss branch while its metric value is nonzero
validity_precondition: PoE training path active with z_loss_multiplier set and the head emitting z_loss as a detached metric
evidence_from_issue: PoE z_loss combined into combined_loss is detached, contributing value but no gradient
evidence_from_fix: LMHead emits output.z_loss as a detached metric tensor; the optimizer saw the value in metrics while backprop applied zero z_loss gradient, so logit-norm regularization never constrained the weights
